chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to me. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa narrated to me. He said: Ali b. al-Hakam narrated to me. He said: al-Husayn b. Abi al-Ala' narrated to me from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said:

Umm Ayman visited the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) and she had something in her coat. So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to her: What do you have with you, O Umm Ayman? She said: Indeed, so-and-so got married, and they sprinkled things upon her, and I took some of what was sprinkled. Then Umm Ayman wept and said: O Messenger of Allah, you married Fatima off but did not sprinkle anything on her.

So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: O Umm Ayman, why do you speak falsely? For indeed, when Allah, blessed and exalted, married Fatima to Ali, He ordered the trees of Paradise to sprinkle upon them from their jewels, garments, rubies, pearls, emeralds, and brocade, and they collected what they could not fathom. And surely Allah bestowed Tuba as the dowry of Fatima and placed it in the house of Ali.

key_terms.استبرق: Thick brocade or silk, mentioned in the Quran as a fabric of Paradise
key_terms.طوبى: Tuba - a tree in Paradise mentioned in Quran 13:29, believed to be of immense size and beauty
key_terms.ملحفة: A large outer garment or wrap
key_terms.مهر: Dowry or bridal gift (mahr) given at marriage
key_terms.نثار: Scattering of gifts or sweets at a wedding celebration

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the wedding of Fatima and Ali in Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a conversation between Umm Ayman and the Prophet Muhammad (s) concerning the wedding of Fatima and Ali. When Umm Ayman expressed concern that nothing was sprinkled at Fatima's wedding, the Prophet informed her that Allah Himself commanded the trees of Paradise to shower treasures upon the couple, and the tree of Tuba was given as part of Fatima's dowry. The narrative highlights the extraordinary celestial status of the marriage of Ali and Fatima in Islamic tradition.
